title: Comment on How Much Should Trump Sue Hillary For? by Skapa ett gratis konto
text:
Did anyone ever think that one day we’d learn that Hillary Clinton okayed the Russian collusion lies the left sold as truth? I mean, who would believe she could do such a thing?
Oh yea, just about every conservative on the planet. Along with most independents and a good chunk of Democrats. But for the sake of argument, let’s just pretend it’s a huge surprise that the three-time loser engaged in such scandalous behavior.
Now, we are well aware that everyone on #TeamHillary knew where the Russian collusion stories came from. And we also know she gave the green light to spread misinformation. And President Trump has just one question for the crooked wretch. “Where do I get my reputation back?”
Trump calls the Russian plot one of the greatest political scandals of all time. And he’s got that right. Thanks to the lies and deceit these Democrats spread, Trump will never fully recover his reputation. But more than the personal damage to Trump, Democrats also used those lies to help put together the Big Cheat.
Sadly, we didn’t just lose the power of running the White House. Our entire country is now on a losing streak reminiscent of the Great Depression. Maybe even worse, as things don’t seem to be getting better any time soon.
Meanwhile, we’re left to try and piece together all the dirty moves Democrats made.
Friday’s testimony from Clinton campaign manager Robby Mook revealed that Hillary agreed to share the false narrative with reporters. Thus, the #FakeNews could spread the leftist propaganda. Oddly enough, Bob Mueller’s $32M investigation failed to reveal Hillary and her vile participation in this disgusting scheme. I wonder how much that omission cost Democrats?
To be honest, many conservatives felt like the Durham probe would be no different. A whole lot of nothing. Then, a few weeks ago, things started moving. Durham came up with a whole lot of offenses. And Clinton is the crown jewel, so to speak.
According to Fox News, “Former FBI General Counsel James Baker testified Thursday that the bureau investigated the data alleging a Trump connection to the Kremlin-linked bank, and found that “there was nothing there.””
Trump responded, saying “For three years, I had to fight her off, and fight those crooked people off, and you’ll never get your reputation fully back.”
“Where do I get my reputation back?” Trump said again.
“I had to fight them off,” Trump said. “And if we had real leadership, instead of people like Mitch McConnell, they would do something about it. And guys like Bill Barr. They would have done something about it.”
Trump said that the law enforcement and intelligence community resources devoted to investigating him and members of his 2016 campaign distracted officials from what “could have been a real danger with Russia.”
Real Danger?
With the cold war long over, some question just how much “real danger” we could really be in over such actions. I implore these people to look around, and see the answer. When someone in the White House takes their eye off the ball, things go south, and fast.
We’ve lost our energy independence. We’re reliant on foreign oil. Gasoline was down to $1.89 under President Trump. Today, I paid $4.35 a gallon, and that’s up a good seventy-five cents since my last doctors appointment about ten days ago.
We’re the laughing stock of the world. Our Afghanistan withdrawal made us look like babbling idiots. Some world leaders won’t even take a call from Joe Biden. And the terrorists Trump chased off the globe are rebuilding their regimes with Biden policing the planet.
At this point, we’re not even food-secure. Grocery stores have empty shelves. The price of goods is astronomical. Meatloaf is forty dollars a pan when it used to be fifteen. It’s like any day now, we’ll be given ration tickets for sugar and milk. We’re going backwards. And if that’s not dangerous, I don’t know what is.
And to think, we have good ole Hillary Clinton to thank for our current state of affairs. Her loss was so devastating to the Democrats, that they orchestrated the biggest cheat in history. They’ve destroyed Trump’s reputation and our sacred nation.
What’s the dollar amount for all that damage?
Especially for Trump. He took the job of president seriously. He made sure he turned us into winners on every front. Trade, foreign policy, military, energy, technology, unemployment, education, criminal justice reform, the stock market, veterans affairs, you name it, and Trump rocked it. You can’t put a dollar amount on that kind of winning.
As for Trump’s reputation, he need not worry. Because those who matter know the real Trump. And those who doubt him, well they don’t really matter. Not in the grand scheme of things. Because if you can’t look around and see the difference between winning and losing, you’re flying blind pal!
